description: Multi-agent KPI-drop investigator: competing hypotheses tested against Zetaris views, a deterministic Claim Gate, an evidence graph in Meterless H-MEM, and a decision memo with row-level citations and a formula-based confidence.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsor_technology.zetaris: Data layer: five views (v_orders, v_returns, v_tickets, v_logistics, v_promotions) queried by the Retriever and re-queried by the Evidence Evaluator and Claim Gate. REST backend implemented, not yet tested live; SAMPLE_MODE uses a DuckDB snapshot with the same views.

meterless.where: H-MEM stores hypotheses, evidence and support/refute edges (trust ledger exported per run); Markovian drives the Evaluator->Planner investigation rounds. Nightshift as primary model provider: pending availability.

sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (S2 reasoning) and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (S1 filter/verifier) via the provider switch; wired, not yet called live.
sponsor_technology.cursor: Development environment for the whole build.
sponsor_technology.unique: The Evidence Evaluator re-queries the data itself and can send the Planner back; a deterministic Claim Gate blocks any claim or model-written number that the data does not support.
